evidence.decision: Distinguishes a selection-following inspector from a stable-object Info window and chooses direct contextual adjustment versus a separate workspace.
evidence.artifact: Requires inspector implementation or context/visibility/window specification, including show/hide command behavior.
evidence.transformation: Stale Mac shape inspector example updates active selection and removes document-list/minimization treatment while adding restoration.
evidence.verification: Checks selection, activation/deactivation, no selection, hide/restore and relevant fullscreen behavior; fails wrong-object editing or stale tools above another app.
evidence.applicability: Explicit Mac-only scope and native key/window-activation limits are preserved, alongside restrained HUD versus standard-panel criteria.
evidence.handoffs: Routes stable-object information to windows, embedded contextual tools to split-views and actual adjustment mechanics to sliders.
evidence.distinctiveness: Context following, main/key ownership, activation visibility and document-list exclusion form concrete panel behavior.
